label: KoLmafia root
purpose: The local KoLmafia working root. Treat it as a container of purpose-specific areas, not as one undifferentiated workspace.

label: scripts/
purpose: Executable ASH/JavaScript and callable automation. Read before running; documentation does not grant execution authority.

label: relay/
purpose: Relay-browser scripts and static UI assets. This is where the Goblin Docs relay surface and an installed kol-html-matrix user UI live.

label: data/
purpose: Script data, generated indexes, local caches, and agent-readable support artifacts. Goblin Docs lives under data/kol-goblin-docs/.

label: sessions/
purpose: Session logs and active-session evidence. Useful for readback and provenance; logs are evidence, not permission to execute.

label: git/
purpose: KoLmafia-managed Git working copies. Presence here identifies installed Git projects; generated/copy-out runtime files live in their normal scripts/relay/data destinations.

label: settings/
purpose: KoLmafia preference files and character/global configuration. High-impact to edit directly; prefer KoLmafia preference APIs and documented settings.

label: ccs/
purpose: Custom Combat Scripts. These can influence combat automation and should be treated as executable behavior.

label: chats/
purpose: Chat logs. Treat as human/social data and observation only; Goblin Docs does not automate chat or messaging.

label: planting/
purpose: Mushroom/planting plot state and related local data.

label: buffs/
purpose: Buffbot configuration/data. Potentially player-facing automation; inspect scope before changing or invoking.

label: images/
purpose: Cached/local image assets used by KoLmafia and relay pages. Usually presentation/cache rather than agent authority.

label: svn/
purpose: Legacy SVN-managed script working copies. Prefer Git for new projects, but document existing legacy installs rather than assuming they are absent.

label: kol-html-matrix (conditional)
purpose: If installed, UI is projected through ~/.kolmafia/relay/ and agent plane is ~/.kolmafia/data/html-matrix/.
